findings.note: ARGUABLE: "the longer routes ran at a loss that no transport ministry seemed willing to ___(2)___ indefinitely" also reads coherently with 'condone' in its loose sense of tolerate — a ministry unwilling to go on tolerating a loss-making route. Beatable: the ministry in this sentence is the payer, not a bystander ('almost all of them survive on public subsidy'), and 'condone' carries an overlooking-of-wrongdoing sense that a balance-sheet loss does not have, so 'underwrite' is the clearly best fit. Pre-existing and rename-independent — the entity repair touched no cloze option text in this unit.

findings.quote: It finally arrived in 1849, several years after the town's first hotels had been built.
findings.note: ARGUABLE: A is factually true and supported ('three hotels went up in as many years' after the 1841 pamphlet; the railway 'finally reached them in 1849'), so it is responsive and tempting. But the prompt asks what the text IMPLIES about the railway; A merely restates an explicit chronological detail rather than the implication, which is D (the line they fought for also let visitors travel onward). Beaten by the 'imply' framing -> attractive but beatable, not a clear second key.

findings.quote: Att varmt vatten är lättare än kallt och därför lägger sig överst i schaktet.

But the prompt asks which claim best matches the text 'som helhet'; A is one local mechanism, not the whole-text thesis (B). Beaten by the 'som helhet' delimiter.

findings.quote: I Bergslagen står hundratals gamla gruvor vattenfyllda sedan brytningen upphörde.
findings.note: ARGUABLE: D is true per the text ('Runt om i Bergslagen står hundratals gamla gruvor ... tysta och fulla av vatten'), hence tempting, but it is a background detail, not the text as a whole. Beaten by the 'som helhet' delimiter; B (a mine can become a modest but real heat store) is clearly best.

findings.quote: Att nattågen möjligen kan ha ett värde, men att ett enda vinterförsök gör det för tidigt att uttala sig.
findings.note: ARGUABLE: C echoes real text material ('ett enda vinterförsök inte säger något säkert om ett helt år'; 'Rådets egen försiktighet är rimlig'), so it is attractive. But the prompt asks the text's own hållning (stance); the author explicitly distances from a wait-and-see verdict ('bör inte förväxlas med ett underkännande'; 'det vore fel slutsats att de därför saknar värde') and advocates treating nattåg as infrastructure (A). C misattributes the council's caution as the author's stance -> beatable, not a clear second key.

comparative_note: Under the amended cloze-format scope rule (owner 2026-07-24) the gap format is out of jurisdiction; judged on in-scope dimensions the passage holds its own beside the exemplars. Genre/source-plausibility is magazine-grade: a signed transport column with real-world residue (Halden Rail, the Aurora service, carriages leased from an operator two countries away, a named economist Ingrid Sollander with an audit and a direct quote), matching the National Geographic History texture of host-2021-verb2-ELF-040 rather than manufactured filler. Intellectual temperature is genuinely adult and complicated: it stages nostalgia/subsidy against arithmetic ("the romance of the sleeper... has for the moment outrun its arithmetic"), the same settled-fact-resisting tension as the OECD-spending and mouse-funding argument items var-2022-1-verb1-ELF-031 and host-ver2-2019-verb1-ELF-031. Option-word register (underwrite/condone/overturn/dispel; auspicious/precarious/gregarious/meticulous) is educated-adult and congruent with the prose, with no listicle tidiness, reader address, or SEO shaping. Indistinguishable in kind from the exemplars; supersedes the prior kill, which rested solely on the cloze format now excluded from this gate.

Round 1 killed this because A carried alltid...aldrig, leaving C the only hedge among absolutes. The rebalanced A is now Oftast ar det den jamna trafiken... and B carries de flesta, so hedging is distributed and all four options are ~13-14 words (no length tell, no position tell). C can no longer be selected by FORM alone: B is a substantive opposing overclaim (rosa brus as the reliable solution), A a specific disturbance claim, D a procedural claim that is plausibly true — each is passage-dependent. Residual lean to C comes from domain knowledge (noise-masking effects are typically conditional) plus a mild nuance heuristic, not from structure.
